rows.headline: Paramount and Warner Bros. merger hit with temporary restraining order

rows.headline: Iran's Houthi allies declare maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia, escalating threat to oil market
rows.prelim_note: Supply/demand-dynamics signal — Houthi forces declared a naval blockade of Saudi Arabia's Red Sea export route, putting ~2.5m bpd of Saudi crude at risk (Rystad Energy) as tankers U-turn; part of the same Iran-conflict cluster already in today's inbox (INB-011/028) but a distinct, quantified oil-supply escalation.
